plan: Queue jungle as primary. It is Xeebs's best role at 53.7% over 329 games (overall is 50.6%). Set support as secondary, not the other way around.
Stop queueing carry: 42.9% over 198 games is costing real VP. When auto-filled there, play the safest comfort pick, not a learning pick.
Two-hero rule for the climb: Khaimera and Greystone. Compared with the average player on the same hero, Xeebs wins about 6.6 and 2.5 more games per 100 on them.
Xeebs's champion pool is 12+ heroes wide and the top three are only 39% of the games. Gold-to-Platinum climbs are almost always pool-narrowing stories: aim for 70%+ of games on the top three.
Park Drongo, Serath for ranked: 37% over 51; 38% over 50. Keep them for normals.
The math: Xeebs is at 515 VP; Platinum III starts at 900. The all-time peak is 692.
